vo-01.text: Most trading games ask you to trust their scoreboard.

vo-02.text: Dream Arena hands the scoreboard to the chain.

vo-03.text: Trade real perps on Dream Dex.

vo-04.text: Then pick a fight: Survivor, Streak, or Boss.

vo-05.text: The moment your position moves, Somm-nia Reactivity calls our contract, in the same block.

vo-06.text: No keeper. No backend. No score anyone can fake.

vo-07.text: Or let an AI agent trade for you, inside hard limits. It can never withdraw.

vo-08.text: Dream Arena. Leverage challenges, refereed by the chain.
